status: measurement design; no production SLO assertion
global_rules: Retain eligible, success, failure and unknown separately; never silently drop failed turns.
A latency distribution includes measured samples only and must show its measured/eligible denominator.
Differences require a common clock or explicit clock calibration; never add p95 values.
Do not multiply rates from different experiments to estimate joint session success.
Target rates, reporting window, quality criteria and permitted exclusions require a real service contract.

metrics.eligible: all formal eligible turns in each exp14 strategy, 36 each
metrics.success: endpoint contains the complete frozen input speech reference

metrics.origin: client scheduled source start + offline energy-reference speech-end offset
metrics.eligible: all exp14 formal turns; distribution conditional on complete endpoint
metrics.failure: premature endpoint remains a separate failure

metrics.end: first non-silent AudioContext sample mapped through recorded bracketed performance anchors; main-thread consumption notification is a separate signal
metrics.eligible: 3 exp14 final browser replay runs only
exp15 final media runs, 6 per transport/scenario
metrics.ws: AudioWorklet underrun samples with that player and playout window
metrics.rtc: concealedSamples from receiver stats; initial missing => interval delta unknown
metrics.unit: path-specific sample counts; NOT a combined stall rate

metrics.clock: AudioContext frame index at context sample rate
metrics.eligible: exp16 18 browser interruption runs, grouped by policy/position
exp16 browser interruption runs; separate GPU boundary probes not pooled

metrics.success: new generation produced/sent/played counts match with no remaining queue at completion

metrics.eligible: real jointly instrumented service sessions under specified load and window

metrics.numerator: per-device union of resident intervals in hours times explicit assumed or paid rate; sum devices separately
metrics.denominator: sum actual session minutes in same window; not input audio or demo-turn minutes
metrics.other_costs: CPU, memory, network, storage, API costs tracked separately
